candidate_shortlist.reason: The official HOSE fee schedule names a paid Market Data Feed but does not publish the ticker/session raw and adjusted-field contract needed for qualification.
FiinGroup documents separate raw price, adjusted price and adjustment-rate fields plus ticker/date and order-matching/put-through totals.
Both active provider verdicts are adjusted and raw_as_traded_eligible=false; they are not re-tested.

not_yet_proven: Contractual confirmation that unadjusted fields are raw/as-traded and non-rewritten.
Historical as-of/revision semantics and deterministic range-query contract.
Odd-lot and auction treatment in TotalVolume.
Payload-level HPG/VNM anchor and event-window evidence.
